_comment: Maps SpellDefinition -> casting animation family -> humanoid.anim clips. Rules are evaluated top-down, first match wins; spellOverrides beat rules. Clip-side metadata (castFamily/castRole/releaseFrame) lives in '# clip_meta:' headers in humanoid.anim, generated by tools/anim_pipeline/generate_casts.py. Reference resolver: tools/anim_pipeline/spell_anim_resolver.py.
_comment_speed: castingTimeTargets are the desired on-screen cast durations in seconds (rituals are visual abstractions, not literal minutes). playback speed = clipDuration/target, clamped to playbackRateRange so motion never looks floaty or comical. Skill: speed *= 1 + skillRatePerProficiency * (proficiencyBonus - 2).
_comment_overrides: fireball: 5e flavor is 'you point your finger and a bead streaks out' -> bolt, not call_down. hold_person: a pointed command at one creature -> bolt.
